content: कलिका .²1 A digit of the moon. .²2 A division of time.

कलिका, -कलिः {%f.%} .²1 An unblown flower; a bud; चूतानां चिरनिर्गताऽपि कलिका बध्नाति न स्वं रजः <ls>Ś. 6. 4</ls>; किमाम्रकलिकाभङ्गमारभसे <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 6. 17</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 33</ls>. .²2 A digit. streak. .²3 The bottom or peg of the Indian lute. .²4 A king of poetic composition (akin to बिरुद).
